title: Typed persistent-state content interface diagnosis for integrated multimodal PLM
question: Can a typed persistent state carrying the supervised 12-bit observation content restore held-out computation after E2E-003 showed that correct structural addressing was not sufficient?
hypothesis: The E2E-003 failure is concentrated in the unconstrained hidden-state-to-CASM content interface. A typed persistent state whose content is the supervised 12-bit representation will materially improve held-out computation, while an oracle typed state should establish the exact downstream execution ceiling.

arms.name: typed_learned
arms.intervention: store the supervised 12-bit representation output in the explicitly addressed persistent slot and execute the requested Boolean operator directly over the stored typed bits

arms.name: typed_oracle
arms.intervention: store the true 12-bit observation payload in the explicitly addressed persistent slot and execute the requested Boolean operator directly over the stored typed bits

decision_rule.licenses: the exact typed downstream execution reference is not behaving as specified and the experiment is instrument-invalid

decision_rule.condition: typed_oracle q2 mean is 1.00 and typed_learned q2 mean is at least 0.80 with every seed at least 0.40
decision_rule.licenses: the supervised typed persistent-state interface meets the registered synthetic capability criterion
decision_rule.does_not_license: learned semantic state addressing, natural multimodal competence, autonomous operator discovery, or scaling

decision_rule.condition: typed_oracle q2 mean is 1.00 and typed_learned q2 mean is below 0.80
decision_rule.licenses: typed persistent content does not meet the registered capability criterion; bit reconstruction and memory controls localize the remaining failure
decision_rule.does_not_license: that typed state, persistent state, CASM, or PLM is impossible

decision_rule.condition: typed_learned q2 mean exceeds the frozen E2E-003 explicit-both mean by at least 0.05
decision_rule.licenses: the typed content interface materially improves this synthetic computation over the frozen hidden-state interface

decision_rule.condition: q1/q2 entity identities overlap, held-out composition appears in TRAIN_COMBOS, answer/outcome enters before action, or arm provenance differs

held_constant: corrected canonical benchmark generator from E2E-003
q1 targets entities[0] and q2 targets entities[1]
same 12 complementary latent bits: text 0-3, image 4-7, audio 8-11
same 300 training steps and 400 evaluation episodes per seed
explicit entity addressing is fixed because E2E-003 showed addressing was not sufficient to rescue the hidden-state interface
the oracle arm is an execution ceiling and is not trained
the frozen E2E-003 mean 0.5200 is a comparator only and is not used for tuning

amendments.new_definition: the regression test fixture is syntactically valid and covers temporal/held-out validity, exact typed execution, and representation gradient flow

amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No E2E-004 measurement existed under the syntax-invalid test.
